You draw a crooked line across the ground. Brambles follow your hand, knitting a thorny screen between your companions and the enemy.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Target / range / shape
Visible unoccupied ground squares within 4 squares, joined along their edges.
Type
Magic / Control / Utility

Make a Reason roll and grow a connected hedge in the indicated number of squares.

Weak
Up to 3 squares.
Standard
Up to 5 squares.
Strong
Up to 7 squares.

The hedge supplies difficult terrain and heavy cover across it until the end of your next turn. On later turns, you may spend a Maneuver to sustain it until the end of your next turn.
